from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single month's housing starts data extracted from one report."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data applies to, format YYYY-MM")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date this specific report was released, format YYYY-MM-DD")
    single_family_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for 1-unit starts, in thousands or units as reported")
    multi_family_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for 5+ unit starts, in thousands or units as reported")
    source_document: str | None = Field(description="Identifier of the document this came from")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_start_data: list[MonthlyDataPoint]
